extension.description: STEP 7 Classic project browser and editor for Windows.
setting.step7project.awl.mnemonics: AWL/STL export dialect for newly opened projects. Match STEP 7 Options > Customize > Language. Existing workspaces: CLI configure --mnemonics, then refresh.
setting.step7project.backup.mode: Backup previous file versions, including observed external/AI writes. Enabled modes also snapshot the native project before apply.
setting.step7project.backup.directory: Backup directory. Empty: .step7project/backups in the editing workspace.
setting.step7project.symbols.editor: Table, built-in text, or default editor (allows third-party CSV editors).
setting.step7project.symbols.format: Canonical symbols format for newly opened projects. Use Choose Symbols Format for existing workspaces.
setting.step7project.backend.path: Optional absolute path to Step7Bridge.exe on the extension host.
view.welcome:
Open a native STEP 7 project or an existing step7project.json. Existing project views inside the workspace are detected automatically.
[Open Project](command:step7project.open)
setting.step7project.projectPath.mode: Native project path stored in new project views. Relative paths support moving both folders together; different drives require an absolute path. Existing views: CLI configure --project-path relative|absolute.
